title: Q-GROW-CASE-STUDY: GROW-6: customer-zero case study generated from the system's own measured record
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order (growth items first when the recent growth share is below target)
**Done check:** file:site/casestudy.js
**Status:** open

Owner directive 2026-11-12: product management is growth, not only bug fixes. Growth item: it adds a capability, a surface, a reader or a customer path.

Generate /proof/customer-zero from the snapshot: what the system shipped this week, which loops ticked, what broke and how it fixed itself (failure registry), what it cost (model cost log), each number linked to its record. No claims without a measured value.
Paths: site/casestudy.js, site/worker.js, site/site.test.mjs.
Acceptance: the page is built from data only and a test fails when a number has no source.
Metric moved: pilot_page_views_7d, visitors_7d.

size: M

**Closing probe:** file:site/casestudy.js and the stated metric measured after the change (keep only if the target moved and no guard worsened).
